title: Fix Auth Token Refresh Bug (401 on expired access token)
taskDescription: Investigating intermittent 401 Unauthorized errors when frontend makes requests right as the 15-minute access token expires. Token refresh interceptor appears to race.
workCompleted: Identified that the Axios response interceptor was catching 401s but didn't queue subsequent requests while refresh was in flight. Implemented an in-memory promise queue in authClient.ts.
lastKnownProblem: Refresh token rotation endpoint /auth/refresh returns 403 Invalid Signature when called concurrently by more than 2 requests. Suspect race condition in Redis token blacklist update.
nextStep: Check the Redis multi/exec transaction in src/services/tokenService.ts (line 84). Ensure atomic blacklist-and-issue before replying to frontend.
validationStatus: Unit tests pass, but concurrent integration test fails 2 out of 10 runs.
recentCommits: 8f41b2a fix(auth): add request queueing to axios response interceptor
12c904e test(auth): add concurrency test for token refresh
5e709a1 feat(auth): add initial JWT verification middleware
aiSummary: Working on a race condition in the JWT silent refresh flow causing intermittent 401/403 errors. Added request queueing in the interceptor, but Redis blacklist rotation still fails under concurrency. Next action is to atomize the Redis transaction in tokenService.ts.

title: Stripe Webhook Signature Verification & Idempotency
taskDescription: Implement checkout.session.completed webhook handler to fulfill customer orders and send confirmation emails.
workCompleted: Constructed raw body parser in Express for webhook route. Implemented HMAC-SHA256 signature verification with Stripe webhook secret.
lastKnownProblem: Raw body parsing interferes with global express.json() middleware if order of app.use() is wrong.
nextStep: Mount express.raw({ type: 'application/json' }) strictly before global body parser on the /api/webhooks route.
validationStatus: Stripe CLI trigger events successfully verified in local simulator.
